CustomField.description: This is used inside of BizAppsSiteModel to tell if the order is ready to be sent to Site or not, For NA it's when the Order_Status__c is "Sent to Verification" and for EU it is for "Verified"
CustomField.formula: OR(ISPICKVAL(OrderStatus__c , 'Sent To Verification'), ISPICKVAL(OrderStatus__c , 'Paid in Full'))
CustomField.label: Auto Trigger Verification
